title: Improve keyboard navigation when focus leaves the workspace delete popup
outcome: Keyboard navigation around a workspace delete confirmation follows a deliberate focus policy without leaving a stale floating confirmation or interfering with unrelated controls.
acceptance: Tab and Shift+Tab from the workspace delete confirmation either follow a deliberate local cycle or close the confirmation with appropriate focus placement; confirm/cancel and pending-delete guards remain correct.
Behavioral keyboard coverage protects the chosen Tab/Shift+Tab policy and preserves outside-control usability and safe focus restoration.
